# Circle of Change Leadership Society

> A private community platform for members of the Circle of Change Leadership Society to connect, learn from recorded sessions, and grow together. Most pages require an approved member account.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Landing entry point — redirects members to the in-app feed and visitors to sign in.
- [Sign in / Sign up](/auth): Member sign in and new-account request (subject to admin approval).

## Optional

- The `/lms/*` routes (feed, recordings, calendar, photo album, chapter, profile, and admin tools) are gated behind member authentication and are not indexed.
